questions.question: What should you know about trains near a railroad crossing?

options.text: You will hear every train that is approaching.
You may not hear a train, even if one is coming.
A train will sound two short horn blasts when approaching.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may not hear a train, even if one is coming.
questions.explanation: Do not assume you will hear an approaching train. The operator may not sound the horn, or the area may prohibit horn use. Even if the horn sounds, noise inside your vehicle may prevent you from hearing the train until it is very close.

questions.question: What should you do when driving through flowing water or a large puddle?

options.text: Speed up.
Gently press the brakes.
Try to stop in the water.

questions.correctAnswerText: Gently press the brakes.
questions.explanation: Avoid driving through large puddles or moving water when possible. If you must drive through water, slow down, shift to a lower gear, and gently press the brakes. This keeps water, mud, and sand out of the brake system.

questions.question: Which is NOT a reason to use your mirrors?

options.text: You are changing lanes.
You are making a turn.
You are checking fuel prices.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are checking fuel prices.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors regularly while driving. It is especially important when turning, changing lanes, merging, and making other maneuvers.

questions.question: How should you brake when driving down a long downhill slope?

options.text: Use only the brakes.
Use mostly brakes and sometimes downshift.
Downshift first, then use the brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Downshift first, then use the brakes.
questions.explanation: Before going down a long hill, shift into a lower gear and then use proper braking. Using only brakes can cause them to overheat and fail. The engine's braking power, strongest in a lower gear, is the main way to control speed on a downgrade.

questions.question: What should you do if the low pressure warning light turns on while driving?

options.text: Stop and park where you are.
Leave the road safely and park as soon as possible.
Keep driving normally.

questions.correctAnswerText: Leave the road safely and park as soon as possible.
questions.explanation: If the low pressure warning light comes on while driving, safely exit the road and park your vehicle right away. Low air pressure means your brakes will not work well enough to stop safely.

questions.question: Is it important to keep space between your vehicle and the one ahead?

options.text: No, it slows traffic flow.
Yes, it gives you time to react to problems.
Only if you have a passenger.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yes, it gives you time to react to problems.
questions.explanation: Safe driving requires space on all sides of your vehicle. This space gives you time to respond if something unexpected happens.

questions.question: What is important when coupling vehicles?

options.text: You can treat all vehicles the same.
Make sure you couple correctly.
Cracks in the mounting are okay.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure you couple correctly.
questions.explanation: Wrong coupling and uncoupling of combination vehicles is very dangerous.

questions.question: What should you check on power steering hoses during a pre-trip inspection?

options.text: Leaks.
That they are connected securely to the battery.
That extra hose pieces are available for repairs.

questions.correctAnswerText: Leaks.
questions.explanation: Before a trip, check the power steering hoses, pumps, and fluid level. Pay special attention to the hoses and look for leaks.

questions.question: What should you do if you see a distracted driver on the road?

options.text: Tailgate them.
Flash your lights at them.
Keep plenty of distance between you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep plenty of distance between you.
questions.explanation: If you see a distracted driver, give them plenty of room and keep a safe following distance.

questions.question: When does air pressure enter the brake chambers in S-cam brakes?

options.text: When the driver presses the brake pedal.
When the driver uses the emergency brake.
When the driver uses the trailer hand valve.

questions.correctAnswerText: When the driver presses the brake pedal.
questions.explanation: When you press the brake pedal in a vehicle with S-cam brakes, air enters the brake chambers. This air pressure pushes out the rods and moves the slack adjusters, which twist the brake camshafts.

questions.question: When driving down a hill, when should you shift to a lower gear?

options.text: As you start moving downward
While you are going downhill and speeding up
Before you start going downhill

questions.correctAnswerText: Before you start going downhill
questions.explanation: Shift to a lower gear before you start down a hill. Slow down first. If you don't, your brakes will work too hard, get too hot, and stop working.

questions.question: What shows how much air pressure is in your vehicle's air tanks?

options.text: The supply pressure gauge
The ABS warning light
The tractor protection valve

questions.correctAnswerText: The supply pressure gauge
questions.explanation: Vehicles with air brakes have a supply pressure gauge. It tells you how much air pressure is in your air tanks.

questions.question: Why is texting while driving especially dangerous?

options.text: It distracts your mind and requires you to take a hand off the wheel.
A message might upset you.
People like to read and might focus too much on their phones.

questions.correctAnswerText: It distracts your mind and requires you to take a hand off the wheel.
questions.explanation: Texting while driving is dangerous because it distracts your mind from the road. You also have to remove at least one hand from the steering wheel.

questions.question: How do you test the low pressure warning signal?

options.text: Turn on the engine and apply the trailer hand brake.
Press and release the brake pedal quickly many times.
Remove wheel chocks and release the parking brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: Press and release the brake pedal quickly many times.
questions.explanation: After the system charges fully, test the warning signal by pressing and releasing the brake pedal quickly. Air will escape from the system. The warning light should turn on when pressure drops to a dangerous level.

questions.question: How should you apply brakes on a vehicle with Anti-Lock Braking System (ABS)?

options.text: The same way you would on a vehicle without ABS.
While the vehicle is in neutral.
Using only the hand brake.

questions.correctAnswerText: The same way you would on a vehicle without ABS.
questions.explanation: On a vehicle with ABS, brake the same way you would on a vehicle without ABS.

questions.question: What should you check on power steering hoses?

options.text: Check them for leaks.
Make sure they are connected to the battery.
Make sure they are carrying fuel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check them for leaks.
questions.explanation: When checking a power steering system, inspect the hoses, pumps, and fluid level. Look for leaks in the hoses.

questions.question: How do you test hydraulic brakes?

options.text: Pump the brake pedal three times. Then press hard on the pedal for five seconds. The pedal should not move.
Pump the brake pedal three times. Then press hard on the pedal for five seconds. The pedal should move slowly toward the floor.
Pump the brake pedal three times. Then press hard on the pedal for five seconds. The pedal should slowly rise.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pump the brake pedal three times. Then press hard on the pedal for five seconds. The pedal should not move.
questions.explanation: Test hydraulic brakes by pumping the pedal three times. Then press hard for five seconds. The pedal should stay still. If it moves, there may be a leak or other problem.

questions.question: What happens when a trailer's wheels lock up?

options.text: The trailer will still be drivable.
The trailer may swing to the side.
The vehicle will stay in control.

questions.correctAnswerText: The trailer may swing to the side.
questions.explanation: When a trailer's wheels lock up, the trailer may swing out and hit other vehicles. This is more likely to happen with lightly loaded trailers.

questions.question: What can happen if air pressure gets too low in an air brake system?

options.text: The brakes may squeak.
The brakes may stop working.
The brakes may not respond quickly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The brakes may stop working.
questions.explanation: If you press and release the brake pedal too many times, air leaves the system faster than the compressor can add it back. If pressure drops too low, the air brakes may not work.

questions.question: What should you use to put out an electrical fire?

options.text: Water
A B:C fire extinguisher
An X fire extinguisher

questions.correctAnswerText: A B:C fire extinguisher
questions.explanation: Use a B:C fire extinguisher on electrical fires and fires with burning liquids. Never use water on an electrical fire.
